title: Allocation elicitation workflow and probabilistic sizing runbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Define a repeatable intake -> eligibility -> approval -> sizing workflow for Dedicated capacity requests that ties explicit throughput guarantees to autoscaling policy templates and fleet guardrails. This ticket delivers (1) an intake schema and eligibility checks for the self-serve Portal and Concierge, (2) decision tree for approvals (auto-approve, manual review, escalation), (3) probabilistic sizing algorithm and simulation harness for recommended reservation sizes and probation windows, and (4) mapping from approved throughput commitments to autoscale policies and fleet-level controls (burst lanes, fallback variants).
acceptance_criteria: Intake form schema published in Confluence with all required fields (workload profile, 95th percentile qps, token distribution, SLOs, region/latency constraints, data residency)
Eligibility rules implemented as a short checklist (auto-approve when low-risk: <X qps, no embargoed data, known billing account) documented
Decision tree PNG and Markdown explaining auto-approve thresholds, manual review signals, and escalation steps is checked into docs repo
Probabilistic sizing runbook provides a formula and example outputs; simulation harness produces a recommendation and 90% confidence bounds for requested capacity
Approved throughput maps to an autoscale policy template (min, target, max pods/GPUs, burst buffer) and a probation policy (initial ramp + 14-day telemetry review)
Telemetry requirements defined (SLO deviations, queue depth, token-level cost delta) and a Console dashboard prototype wireframe linked
End-to-end example: intake -> auto-approve -> provisioned fleet -> 14-day probation -> either full commit or scale-down — demonstrated via simulation and sign-off by Eng and Infra PMs
plan: Draft intake schema and sample form fields; iterate with Solutions and Sales to capture customer needs
Define auto-approve thresholds and signals that require manual review (security, unusual token distribution, multi-region constraints)
Work with Runtime and Infra to derive resource mapping from QPS/token profile -> GPU count -> autoscale template
Build a probabilistic sizing simulator (input historical load patterns + burst model) and run against 10 representative customer workloads
Document probation lifecycle, monitoring playbook, and rollback criteria; include cost recovery and billing implications
Create Console wireframe for reservation status, probation health, and action buttons (decommit, extend probation, escalate)
Stakeholder review: Tech PMs, Runtime Eng, Sales Ops, Legal for contractual language around guarantees
